summary.text: Sue Sosnowski is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 37 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
She co-owns and operates Sosnowski Farms and has served in the Senate since 1997.

paragraphs.text: V. Susan Sosnowski received her diploma from Chariho Regional High School in 1973 and later attended the University of Rhode Island, the Community College of Rhode Island and Ocean State Business Institute.

Her professional experience includes retail sales for the Flemings Department Store from 1980 to 1984, work as a sod harvester for Green Valley Turf Farm, a management role at Laurel Brook Farm, and co-owning and operating Sosnowski Farms since 1984.
Sosnowski assumed office in the Rhode Island State Senate in 1997, and her current term ends on January 5, 2027.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Commerce Committee and a member of the Senate Finance Committee and the Senate Labor Committee.
